renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics (0x0000A78B) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
notes: Run this script alone, without another GPU/browser benchmark or DevTools profiler. API auth/list calls are mocked; the verified native TCPAK and locked engine are real. All game progress uses normal mouse UI controls, including the 16x setting; no private state or resource injection. Hashing, GPU queries, screenshots and heap/stat snapshots are outside timed phases. CPU is synchronous PlayerFrame submission and can include driver waits; intervals are observed call cadence, not direct GPU/compositor frame-time measurements. A passed run without a configured CPU budget means observation/functional completion, not a universal FPS guarantee.
statusMeaning: The configured synchronous PlayerFrame CPU P95 budget of 8 ms and functional completion passed. Observed frame intervals do not establish stable 60 FPS; cadence has no passing threshold in this run.

captureScope.execution: Independent Chrome headless performance run against the final production build and published c284 runtime bytes; no parallel benchmark or profiler.
captureScope.systemContext: The same QA session observed GPU activity from the user-owned Return Unity 6 editor, wallpaper application and desktop compositor. These applications were left running. This is environmental context, not a controlled isolation of each process contribution.
captureScope.excludedFromTiming: Engine/package hash verification, screenshots and heap/stat snapshots. First download and engine startup are not steady-state samples.

sourceHashVerification: Computed while preparing this summary after the performance run; current game scripts and README were byte-compared with the final downloadable source archive. These fields supplement the original evidence and were not emitted by the timing harness.
